04 SELECTED PROJECTS
01 / 04FULL-STACK PLATFORM · 2026

FeedBack — Food Rescue & Distribution

FeedBack brings food vendors, recipients, NGOs and delivery riders into one platform to make surplus food easier to share. Vendors can publish discounted listings or offer food for donation, while recipients can find available items and NGOs can verify requests. The project links those steps with delivery management and a confirmed pickup process, supporting a clearer handoff from the person offering food to the person collecting it.

01

A complete sharing flowCombines discounted listings, donation requests, vendor offers, NGO verification and delivery coordination across different user roles.

02

Verified collectionQR and one-time password (OTP) pickup checks give the project a clear final step when food changes hands.

02 / 04COMPUTER VISION · 2026

AI-Powered Hazard Detection

This mobile application helps people review potential workplace and facility hazards in a photo they upload or capture. Multiple YOLOv8 models analyze the image, and the app pairs detections with confidence scores and severity classifications so a user can see what the system identified and how it assessed each finding. AI-generated safety recommendations add practical next-step guidance to the visual review.

01

From image to assessmentCombines image detection, confidence scoring and severity classification in one mobile workflow.

02

Recommendations alongside detectionUses the Gemini API to generate safety guidance after hazards have been reviewed.

FlutterDartSpring BootJavaPythonFastAPIYOLOv8Gemini API

03 / 04FINAL YEAR PROJECT · IN DEVELOPMENT

AI-Assisted Oyster Mushroom Yield Forecasting

This ongoing final year project explores how environmental readings and images of oyster mushroom growth can work together to support yield forecasting. An ESP32 with IoT sensors monitors growing conditions, while computer vision is intended to analyze growth through YOLO-based image segmentation. A Random Forest regression model is planned to use the gathered growing and image-derived data to estimate yield; a web dashboard is part of the project design for presenting observations and forecasts.

01

Observe growing conditionsESP32 and connected sensors collect environmental data for the growing process.

02

Connect visual growth to yield estimatesYOLO-based segmentation and Random Forest regression bring computer vision and machine learning into the forecast.

PythonESP32IoT sensorsYOLOScikit-learnComputer vision
Currently in development
04 / 04PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS · 2026

AI Event Recommender for Students

The event recommender helps students find campus activities that match what they are interested in. Rather than presenting every event as equally relevant, it uses embeddings and semantic similarity to compare student preferences with event information, then rank suggestions around that match. The project brings a React and Vite interface together with a Python recommendation service and PostgreSQL data layer.

01

Match meaning, not just keywordsEmbeddings and semantic similarity help relate a student's interests to the meaning of an event description.

02

Rank a more relevant campus feedPersonalized ranking surfaces activities based on each student's stated preferences.
